name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2014 in Intrusions (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. The 14 ATT&CK for ICS techniques the verified 2014 record supports: the eight techniques ATT&CK lists for S0093 Backdoor.Oldrea (Havex) and the two it lists for G0035 Dragonfly, from ICS-CERT's Havex alert and advisory and the June and July 2014 vendor reports; ICS-CERT's alert on BlackEnergy against internet-connected HMIs and the GE Cimplicity flaw CVE-2014-0751; and BSI's account of the German steel mill attack, whose impact techniques are Inferred. No 2014 source prints an ATT&CK id. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2014.md. Scores: 100 the ATT&CK object prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
